6.362 rsInvalidRelationshipGroupingContainerNotNaturalGroup
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidRelationshipGroupingContainerNotNaturalGroup is a critical error that will occur when a
Relationship for a data scope specifies NaturalJoin but the containing data scope does not specify
NaturalGroup. NaturalJoin is only effective if all containing groups specify NaturalGroup.
